Mechanism: Run synchronously waits preceding.Task; same-drain ThreadStatic reentrancy only. Actual configurable external/local function factories can request host ProcessInfo of other owners.
Counterexample: Thread A is drainA current and factoryA waits until factoryB enters; factoryB thread is drainB current.
FactoryA requests ProcessInfo(ownerB), reaches drainB.Run and waits its completion.
FactoryB requests ProcessInfo(ownerA), reaches drainA.Run and waits its completion.
No runtime/mailbox gate held; both completion tasks resolve only after callbacks return, creating permanent logical wait cycle.
RepairRequirement: Explicit bounded nested foreign drain/callback boundary or deterministic cycle protection before blocking; preserve normal public process_info behavior, pure native function factories and same-owner safe admitted-prefix snapshot.
RequiredControls: Two real concurrent owner preparations/custom function factories with cross-owner ProcessInfo and bounded barrier/deadline
